description: Source code for a class managing system services configuration in a kickstart installation script, including parsing command-line options and generating configuration output.

classes.name: FC6_Services
classes.description: Represents a system services configuration command in a kickstart file, allowing enabling/disabling services and generating corresponding script output.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the FC6_Services object, setting up parser and service lists.

methods.name: __str__
methods.description: Generates the string representation of the services command, including disabled/enabled services.

methods.name: _getParser
methods.description: Creates and returns an option parser for the services command.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to set service enable/disable states, raising error if neither is provided.
